clearCache.title: Refreshing your saved copy
clearCache.body: Your browser has been asked to drop the files it saved from this site. You will be taken back to the home page in a moment.
clearCache.fallback: If the site still looks out of date, do a hard refresh. Press Ctrl and Shift and R on Windows or Linux, or Command and Shift and R on a Mac. Safari and Firefox ignore the clearing request, so the hard refresh is the way to go there.
